reviews.text: I have been bought this product just to try how it’s works. And it’s definitely worse it. After using my skin is so clean and soft) so I’m thinking about buying a full sizes of this product)
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢款產品，只係想試吓效果點。而且絕對值得。用完之後我嘅皮膚好清潔、好軟滑，所以我正考慮買返全尺寸嘅呢款產品。

reviews.text: I have been using the matcha serum for quite a while now. The serum controlled the sebum on my face since the first night I used it and that makes my pores look so much better. I am excited about using the whole matcha line.
reviews.zh: 我用咗抹茶精華一段時間。呢款精華由第一晚開始就控制咗我面上嘅油脂，令我嘅毛孔睇落好咗好多。我好期待用晒成個抹茶系列。

reviews.text: I have purchased this product multiple times, I lile every product in the box and I also use the full size ones, I think this makes a great gift and it is always useful to have travel size for the skincare you use on a daily basis
reviews.zh: 我已經買咗呢款產品好多次，我好鍾意盒入面每一樣產品，而且我都會用全尺寸嗰啲。我覺得佢好適合做禮物，而且每日用嘅護膚品有旅行裝一定好實用。

reviews.text:
I bought this trial kit because I've tried some by mi super matcha pore clean clay mask, it's so good, I really like it, it can clean my pores, my face becomes soft, and moisturizing as well. It has a scent of matcha.
My skin type is oily, I haven't tried anything else from this line but I hope it will suit my skin too. The minis size is so cute.
reviews.zh:
我買咗呢個試用裝，因為我試過 Some By Mi 超級抹茶毛孔清潔泥膜，好好用，我好鍾意，佢可以清潔毛孔，令我嘅皮膚變得軟滑、亦都好滋潤。佢有抹茶嘅香味。
我嘅皮膚屬油性，我未試過呢個系列嘅其他產品，但希望佢都啱我嘅皮膚。迷你裝好得意。

reviews.text: I have troubled skin with pimples and acne prones skin. This line it's quite a blessing. reduces all of them. Also the little redness i have and always had is gone. I lime that is a first trial kit but not with small sample.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚有問題，有暗瘡，又容易生痘痘。呢個系列對我嚟講真係好大幫助，全部都減少咗。我一直都有啲少少紅，而家都冇咗。我鍾意佢係第一次試用套裝，但唔係細細樣本。

reviews.text: I have been using the matcha serum for quiet a while now. I’m gonna be honest, my pores are still pretty big BUT they do look better now. The serum controlled the sebum on my face since the first night I used it and that makes my pores look so much better. I am excited about using the whole matcha line. Plus, the size of the products it’s bigger than what I expected.
reviews.zh: 我用咗抹茶精華一段時間。老實講，我嘅毛孔仲係好大，不過而家睇落好咗啲。呢款精華由第一晚開始就控制咗我面上嘅油脂，令我嘅毛孔睇落好咗好多。我好期待用晒成個抹茶系列。而且，產品嘅大小比我預期嘅大。

reviews.text:
I am really really happy with this kit from Some By Mi
I enjoy a lot the texture and how soft I feel my skin... 
Also the smell is so good and just need a really small amount of product every time I used
For sure I will buy again!
reviews.zh:
我真係好好滿意呢套 Some By Mi 產品。
我好鍾意佢嘅質地，以及皮膚摸落幾軟……
香味都好好聞，每次用只需要好少少分量。
我一定會再買！

reviews.text: i haven't yet tried this product yet for i first started my 30 days miracle first but most probably will update my review if i started using this because I too have pore problems.Packaging it's really looking good.
reviews.zh: 我仲未試過呢款產品，因為我而家先開始用 30 Days Miracle 嗰個系列，不過如果我開始用呢款，我好大機會會更新評論，因為我都有毛孔問題。包裝睇落真係好靚。
